chunks: And from him, from Muawiyah ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Ali ibn al-Husayn (peace be upon him) used to place the knife in the hand of a child, then the man would grasp the hand of the child, and he would slaughter.
ai.seo_question: How did the Imams involve children in the ritual of slaughtering animals?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam Sajjad (AS) highlights the permissibility of a child's slaughter being validated by an adult's guidance, reflecting the Shia juristic principle that the physical act of slaughter does not strictly require the slaughterer to be an adult or fully mature, provided the essential conditions are met. It underscores the pedagogical value of involving youth in religious rituals, a practice rooted in the practical teachings of the Ahl al-Bayt to normalize sacred duties from an early age.
